shrink.label: Shrinkage
shrink.note: Dimensions are interpreted as fired size. The template is scaled ×{factor} (seam allowance is treated as wet size and not scaled).

discs.label: Base & lid
discs.note: Discs are drawn at the given diameter, with no seam allowance.

shape.label: Your shape
shape.empty: Enter dimensions to see the shape

canvas.empty: Enter two diameters and a height greater than zero to draw the template.
canvas.hint: Scale 1:1 — verify with the {ruler} in the template after printing. Print at {pct} (no "fit to page").

pdf.title: Konform — template 1:1 scale
pdf.step1: 1. Print all {n} template pages at 100% ("Actual size", no scaling).
pdf.step2: 2. Verify scale with the 10 cm ruler below.
pdf.step3: 3. Cut out each page along the solid line.
pdf.step4: 4. Lay the pieces edge to edge. A dashed edge marked
pdf.step5: "tape → page N" matches the same mark on page N.
pdf.step6: 5. Align the crosses (+) and tape on the back.
pdf.legend: solid = cut   ·   dash-dot = tape seam   ·   + = registration mark

faces.label: Corners (faceted shape)
faces.noteRound: Round shape. Untick Round to give a ring corners.
faces.noteFaceted: Side length is the measurement across one face. The template shows each side once with how many to cut.

warn.mixed: Mixing a round ring with a faceted one is untested. The template is split into many small pieces and we are unsure how well it works in practice.
